name: Bodhrán jig
desc: Irish session bodhrán in 6/8 jig time: the DUM-di-di DUM-di-di tipper pattern on a vcsl frame drum, accent on beats one and four, rim clicks sneaking in as the tune lifts. Peak rolls double-time like the last time through a Kesh Jig set; a low-passed darbuka carries the bodhran's deep "dum" body under the frame-drum skin.

code.full: stack(s("darbuka ~ ~ darbuka ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.45).lpf(1500).pan(.5), s("framedrum*6").gain("[.88 .4 .52]*2").speed("[1 1.5 1.35]*2").shape(.5), s("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~]>").gain(.3).hpf(2000)).room(.2).fast(${rate}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("darbuka ~ ~ darbuka ~ darbuka").gain(${gain}*.9).shape(.5).lpf(1600).pan(.5), s("framedrum*6").gain("[.9 .46 .58]*2").speed("[1 1.5 1.35]*2").shape(.55), s("[~ rim ~]*2").gain("[.26 .18]").hpf(2000), s("<~ ~ ~ [framedrum framedrum framedrum framedrum framedrum framedrum]>").speed(1.6).gain(.62).shape(.4)).room(.2).fast(${rate}).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
